name: 25_grocery_note_live
task: Summon echoecho by voice and ask for a grocery list shown on screen: a note lands in the live workspace, the viewer serves it, and a spoken follow-up updates the same note in place — the 'live note that tracks the conversation' promise.
turns: make me a grocery list and show it on the screen. I need eggs, whole milk, and sourdough bread
add avocados and olive oil to the grocery list
success_criteria: echoecho dispatches a background task for the list instead of refusing or stalling
a markdown grocery note with the three starter items lands in the workspace
the spoken follow-up updates the same note (avocados and olive oil appear)
the note is served by the live viewer
task completion is woven back into the conversation as an injection
red_flags: claims it cannot write or save documents
says the list was written before the task's done line
creates a second file instead of updating the grocery note
